name: alt-shift
description: Fixes Steam On-Screen Keyboard input on Wayland and Game Mode

scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist && rollup -c && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let c = fs.readFileSync('dist/index.js', 'utf8'); if (c.startsWith('var ')) { fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.js', c.replace(/^var \w+ =\s*/, '')); }"

author: Kowalski
